summary: Russia launched massive drone and missile attacks on Ukraine's southern ports and cities, killing civilians in Mykolaiv and Kryvyi Rih, while Ukraine struck Russian oil refineries and airfields deep inside Russia including Perm, Marinovka, and Akhtubinsk. Russian forces advanced near Illinivka and Privillya in Donetsk region. Ukraine faces a $36 billion funding shortfall as EU refuses additional aid to farmers.
key_points: Russian drone strikes on Mykolaiv killed four people including three children aged 11-12, hitting a shop, pharmacy, and post office (Source: @UkraineNow/83597).
Ukrainian drones attacked Lukoil-Perm refinery, Marinovka airfield in Volgograd, Akhtubinsk airfield damaging a Su-34, and drone storage in Primorsko-Akhtarsk (Source: @UkraineNow/83584).
Massive Russian drone assault on Odesa region with 20 Shaheds and jet-powered drones, plus Kh-31P missiles targeting Chornomorsk port (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70933).
Double-tap drone strike on shopping center in Kryvyi Rih during rescue operations killed two and injured 15 (Source: @UkraineNow/83593).
DeepState map shows Russian advances near Illinivka and Privillya in Donetsk region (Source: @DeepStateUA/23760).
Ukraine's ports in Greater Odesa idle for a month, causing $2.17 billion in lost revenue and 90% drop in grain exports (Source: @tass_agency/391436).
Ukraine developed a domestic jet-powered interceptor drone to counter Russian Geran-3/4/5 and Shahed-131 attack drones (Source: @UkraineNow/83600).
EU refused €220 million in additional aid to Ukrainian farmers affected by port closures (Source: @tass_agency/391431).

sections.executive_summary: Russia intensified multi-axis attacks on Ukraine's southern infrastructure with massed Shahed and jet-powered drones plus anti-ship missiles, killing civilians in Mykolaiv and Kryvyi Rih while paralyzing grain exports. Ukraine responded with deep strikes hitting four strategic Russian sites including the Perm refinery 1,600km from the border, Marinovka and Akhtubinsk airfields, and drone facilities in Primorsko-Akhtarsk. Russian ground forces made incremental gains near Illinivka and Privillya in Donetsk oblast as Ukraine faces a $36 billion funding gap and EU aid refusal.

points: Ukrainian drones struck Lukoil-Permnefteorgsintez refinery in Perm (1,600km from border), Marinovka military airfield in Volgograd region, Akhtubinsk airfield damaging a Su-34 fighter-bomber, and drone storage/launch facilities in Primorsko-Akhtarsk, Krasnodar region (Source: @UkraineNow/83584).

Ukraine unveiled a domestically produced jet-powered interceptor drone designed to destroy Russian Geran-3/4/5 and Shahed-131 attack drones, as well as reconnaissance UAVs and helicopters (Source: @UkraineNow/83600).

Over 300 Ukrainian gas stations destroyed or damaged in six months, now classified as critical infrastructure; energy minister confirmed severe damage to electrical grid from Russian attacks (Source: @UkraineNow/83585).
Ukraine's 2026 budget seeks $49 billion in international support but has received less than $13 billion to date, leaving a $36 billion shortfall per TASS calculations (Source: @tass_agency/391437).

National Anti-Corruption Bureau filed notice of suspicion against former deputy head of presidential office Mudra, implicating Chief of Staff Budanov; ex-Energy Minister Galushchenko released on 150 million UAH bail in 'Midas' money laundering case (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32623, @ukr_leaks_eng/32643).

Russian forces launched massive drone assault on Odesa and Mykolaiv regions including 20 Shaheds, jet-powered UAVs, and Kh-31P anti-radiation missiles targeting Chornomorsk port; Su-34 fighter-bombers operated over Black Sea with Kh-59 missile threat (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70933, @kpszsu/73918, @mon1tor_ua/70900).

Russian missile strikes hit Mykolaiv city killing four civilians including three children (ages 11, 11, 12) and damaging a shop, pharmacy, and post office; double-tap drone strike on Kryvyi Rih shopping center during rescue operations killed two and injured 15 (Source: @UkraineNow/83597, @UkraineNow/83593).

Russian cruise missiles ('Banderyol') launched from Belgorod and Kursk regions targeted Zhytomyr, Sumy, Chernihiv, and Kyiv oblasts; one missile flew 141km into Belarus toward Salihorsk (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70931, @mon1tor_ua/70896, @mon1tor_ua/70920).

Russian troops advanced near Illinivka and Privillya in Donetsk region per DeepState map update; strikes conducted on Ukrainian drone storage near Donetsk, MTZ depot in Novosilskoye (Crimea), and two command posts in Zaporizhzhia sector (Source: @DeepStateUA/23760, @UkraineNow/83588).
Russian Navy conducted missile tests near disputed Southern Kuril Islands claimed by Japan; Japanese Foreign Minister protested military buildup on four northern islands (Source: @UkraineNow/83582).
Russian forces advanced near Illinivka and Privillya in Donetsk oblast according to DeepState map update (Source: @DeepStateUA/23760).

Ukrainian strikes hit Russian drone storage/launch site near Donetsk, MTZ supply depot in Novosilskoye (Crimea), and two command posts in Zaporizhzhia sector at Donetsk and Kobylne (Source: @UkraineNow/83588).
Six ground-based drone relay stations destroyed in Crimea during Ukrainian operations on August 20-21 (Source: @UkraineNow/83588).
Russian tactical aviation including Su-34 fighter-bombers active over Black Sea posing Kh-59 missile threat to southern Ukrainian regions (Source: @kpszsu/73918, @mon1tor_ua/70900).
Russian jet-powered drones launched from Belgorod region targeted Kharkiv oblast toward Bohodukhiv and Krasnokutsk (Source: @kpszsu/73901).

Multiple 'Banderyol' cruise missiles launched from Sumy and Chernihiv regions toward Kyiv and Zhytomyr oblasts; one missile transited 141km into Belarus toward Salihorsk (Source: @kpszsu/73861, @mon1tor_ua/70920).
Belarusian Su-30 fighter scrambled from Baranovichi airfield to intercept a Russian missile (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70926).
Jet-powered drones and cruise missiles targeted Zhytomyr region from Horodok area; air raid alerts active across northern Ukraine (Source: @eRadarrua/106653, @mon1tor_ua/70931).

Massive Russian drone attack on Odesa coastline with Shaheds, jet-powered UAVs, and Kh-31P missiles targeting Chornomorsk port; air battles reported over Black Sea waters (Source: @kpszsu/73886, @eRadarrua/106644, @mon1tor_ua/70927).
Russian drones from Kherson region struck Mykolaiv oblast toward Snigirevka; additional jet-powered drones hit Bereznehuvate and Snihurivka in Mykolaiv region (Source: @kpszsu/73867, @kpszsu/73913).

Drone groups targeted southern Odesa region toward Izmail and Katlabuh; Mykolaiv oblast attacked from multiple vectors including Berezanka, Nova Odesa, and Voznesensk (Source: @kpszsu/73894, @kpszsu/73913).

Mykolaiv city struck by Russian missiles killing four civilians including three children; port infrastructure in Greater Odesa idle for a month with $2.17 billion losses (Source: @UkraineNow/83597, @tass_agency/391436).

Ukrainian drones struck four strategic Russian targets: Perm refinery (1,600km depth), Marinovka airfield (Volgograd), Akhtubinsk airfield (Su-34 damaged), and Primorsko-Akhtarsk drone facilities (Source: @UkraineNow/83584, @UkraineNow/83580).

Russia deployed 20 Shahed-type drones plus jet-powered UAVs against Odesa and Mykolaiv regions; Kh-31P anti-radiation missiles used against Chornomorsk port (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70933, @mon1tor_ua/70927).

Russian 'Banderyol' cruise missiles launched from multiple northern vectors targeting Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Sumy, Chernihiv regions; one missile entered Belarusian airspace (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70931, @mon1tor_ua/70896, @mon1tor_ua/70920).
Ukraine fielded new jet-powered interceptor drone to counter Geran-3/4/5 and Shahed-131 attack drones, plus reconnaissance UAVs and helicopters (Source: @UkraineNow/83600).
Russian Su-34 fighter-bombers operating over Black Sea with Kh-59 cruise missile capability threatening southern Ukraine (Source: @kpszsu/73918, @mon1tor_ua/70900).

key_developments: Russian mass drone/missile attack on Odesa/Mykolaiv ports with 20 Shaheds, jet UAVs, Kh-31P missiles; Su-34s over Black Sea with Kh-59 threat (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70933, @kpszsu/73918).
Ukrainian deep strikes hit Perm refinery (1,600km), Marinovka airfield, Akhtubinsk airfield (Su-34 damaged), Primorsko-Akhtarsk drone facilities (Source: @UkraineNow/83584).
Mykolaiv missile strike kills 4 including 3 children (11,11,12); Kryvyi Rih double-tap drone strike on mall kills 2, injures 15 during rescue (Source: @UkraineNow/83597, @UkraineNow/83593).

Russian advances near Illinivka and Privillya in Donetsk; Ukrainian strikes on drone storage, MTZ depot in Crimea, 2 command posts in Zaporizhzhia, 6 relay stations (Source: @DeepStateUA/23760, @UkraineNow/83588).

Ukraine's Greater Odesa ports idle 1 month, $2.17B losses, 90% grain export drop; EU refuses €220M farmer aid; $36B funding gap for 2026 (Source: @tass_agency/391436, @tass_agency/391431, @tass_agency/391437).
Ukraine deploys new jet-powered interceptor drone against Geran-3/4/5 and Shahed-131; 300+ gas stations destroyed in 6 months (Source: @UkraineNow/83600, @UkraineNow/83585).

Russian missile tests near disputed Kuril Islands; Belarus Su-30 intercepts Russian missile; 'Banderyol' cruise missiles transit Belarus (Source: @UkraineNow/83582, @mon1tor_ua/70926, @mon1tor_ua/70920).
sections.threat_assessment: Russia is executing a coordinated campaign to strangle Ukraine's maritime export capacity while terrorizing southern cities with massed drone salvos and precision missiles, demonstrating ability to saturate air defenses across Odesa and Mykolaiv oblasts. Ukraine's asymmetric response targeting Russian energy and aviation infrastructure at 1,600km depth degrades Russian warfighting sustainability but invites escalation. The Kremlin's incremental Donetsk gains near Illinivka/Privillya suggest continued pressure on Pokrovsk logistics. With Ukraine's $36 billion funding gap and EU aid refusal, Western sustainment is the critical vulnerability.
sections.regional_response: Belarus's interception of a Russian missile by a Su-30 from Baranovichi indicates Minsk's unwillingness to absorb stray Russian ordnance, potentially complicating Russian northern launch corridors. Japan's formal protest over Russian missile tests near the Southern Kurils signals Tokyo's heightened sensitivity to Russian military activity on disputed territories. The EU's refusal of €220 million in farmer aid despite $2.17 billion monthly port losses reveals fragmentation in European economic support. These reactions collectively constrain Russian freedom of action while undermining Ukraine's economic resilience.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukraine's new jet-powered interceptor drone specifically designed to counter Geran-3/4/5 and Shahed-131 variants suggests Russian attack drone evolution has outpaced existing air defense cost-exchange ratios. The double-tap strike on Kryvyi Rih rescuers indicates Russian adoption of terrorist tactics targeting first responders. Russian 'Banderyol' cruise missiles transiting Belarusian airspace toward Salihorsk imply either navigation failure or deliberate signaling to Minsk. Corruption investigations touching Budanov and Galushchenko risk destabilizing Ukraine's defense leadership amid manpower shortages evidenced by soldiers fleeing German training.
